case_number: Civil Appeal No. 352 of 2023 (@ SLP (C) No. 1488 of 2023) (@ Diary No. 25267 of 2022)
summary: Land acquisition lapse under Right to Fair Compensation Act, 2013 s.24(2); twin conditions for lapse: non-possession AND non-compensation; possession taken on 12.03.1981; High Court relied on overruled Pune Municipal Corporation precedent; Constitution Bench in Indore Development Authority (2020) held 'or' must read as 'nor'/'and'; deemed lapse requires both conditions unfulfilled for 5+ years; acquisition validated as possession already taken; writ petition declaring acquisition lapse set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 s.24(1)(a)
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 s.24(1)(b)
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 s.24(2)
Indore Development Authority Vs. Manoharlal and Ors., (2020) 8 SCC 129
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned High Court judgment quashed and set aside; writ petition dismissed.
